thread:
Noah Rivera: Heads-up: we are GA-ing VisionStream (visionstream-v1) next Tuesday. This is the new hosted streaming endpoint that accepts mixed image + text inputs and supports tool-calls. GA rollout plan and dev migration guidance below. :sparkles:

Priya Singh: New endpoint: /v2/vision/stream with param model=visionstream-v1. Old /v1/vision_stream will remain for 60 days then start returning deprecation headers. Please upgrade SDKs — Python/TS packages already published (`redwood@2.1.0`).

Priya Singh: Quick curl example for streaming + tool hints:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"visionstream-v1","inputs":[{"type":"image","url":"https://.../photo.png"},{"type":"text","text":"Extract table data"}],"stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v2/vision/stream
```

Zoe - PM: Customer notes: we'll email active streaming customers on Monday with migration steps and host a short live Q&A Wed. @Priya can you attach the one-page migration checklist to the customer email?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for visionstream-v1 00-22355-01. Traffic plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~4h if metrics stable. Canary logs: https://internal.deploys/200-22355-01

Priya Singh: Ops targets: p50 token latency <= 140ms, p95 <= 1s. Watch metrics named vs-p50-token, vs-p95-token, vs-image-decode-errors. Auto-retry policy will fall back to text-only worker `text-compat-v1` on persistent image decode failures.

infra-watchdog: Reminder: Dedicated & Private customers who pin a model artifact will not be auto-upgraded. Private control plane push scheduled for next maintenance window; we'll provide a toggle in the console to opt-in.

Priya Singh: Migration snippet (JS):
```
// old: client.openStream('/v1/vision_stream')
client.generateStream({ model: 'visionstream-v1', inputs: [...] , stream: true })
```
Old endpoint responses will include header `x-redwood-will-deprecate: v1-vision;expires=60d` and a body hint with migration url.

Zoe - PM: Docs and changelog: DocsBot, can you confirm the migration doc link?

DocsBot: Docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/visionstream-v1. Changelog entry: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog#visionstream-v1-ga. Migration checklist attached to the docs page.

Noah Rivera: SRE runbooks updated: search `runbooks/visionstream/` for fallback, image-queue-backpressure, and toolcall-throttle. Paging threshold: error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m -> page eng-oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary moved to 25% (no critical alerts). Proceeding to 100% in 2h unless SRE flags. :rocket:

Priya Singh: Note on large assets: we enforce a 8MB per-image soft limit on decode in GA mode; images above that are rejected with 413 and a guidance header. We'll revisit after customer feedback.

Zoe - PM: After 24h of stable traffic we'll publish the public blog and schedule the Wednesday Q&A. @Noah please confirm monitoring dashboards ready by EOD.

Noah Rivera: Dashboards updated: Prod > visionstream-v1 > Overview and Alerts. Will post the Grafana links here once stable.

Priya Singh: One last callout: tool-calls with streaming can interleave metadata frames. If you see misordered frames, capture full session logs and open an incident with label `visionstream-frame-order`.

Noah Rivera: Thanks all. Please surface any edge cases in this thread. :eyes:
